new_text: To book, first call propose_booking. Read the returned summary back to the caller in plain words: service, address, day, date, and window. Ask if this summary is correct and wait for the caller's clear agreement. Only after the caller agrees, call confirm_booking with the token. If the caller changes anything, call propose_booking again with the new details. If they decline, call decline_proposal.
rationale: The previous instruction allowed the agent to state an appointment was 'scheduled' before the confirmation tool was called; this edit forces the agent to present the proposal as a draft for agreement before finalizing the booking.
